archive: archive/ holds past editions: read only, never run; to rerun one, use the old release install.
step: step 7 DECIDE of ALARM_PIPELINE_V1 section 1, after the GRADE job (and the ENTRY job for a variant whose hand-off R1 passed)
question: What is the label of one graded variant (PASS, NEEDS MORE MONTHS, STOP, INSUFFICIENT, INVALID or NO ENTRY), with CLEAR beside it?

commands.name: decide
commands.does: prints the decision of one variant from its job receipts; with --write it appends one DECISIONS row

args.name: --settings
args.meaning: this machine's settings file (KEY=VALUE lines read by _tools/settings_v1.py); always named on the command line

args.name: --grade
args.meaning: the GRADE job of the idea (its receipts name)

args.name: --entry
args.meaning: the ENTRY job; needed when the hand-off R1 passed

args.name: --entry-too-big
args.meaning: R1 passed but the ENTRY job would declare more than the run disk budget: records NO ENTRY (refused when the ENTRY fits)

args.name: --write
args.meaning: append the DECISIONS row (refused when the same decision is already the latest one)

commands.writes: nothing without --write; with --write one row of RUN/registers/DECISIONS.tsv (through reg_append_v1.py)

refuses.when: REFUSED: <reason> on stderr: bad usage or names; no --settings; the variant not in VARIANTS; --grade not a GRADE job of the idea; no receipts or no end line; the variant not graded in that job; a variant with R1 and no --entry (or --entry-too-big when its ENTRY fits); --entry not an ENTRY job of the idea or without the variant; read_stratentry_v1.py or reg_append_v1.py changed; the same decision already written

dry_runs.prints: HAS R1: run its ENTRY job first

rules: reads text receipts under RESEARCH_ROOT only (no market data, no scratch); writes one DECISIONS row with --write, nothing else
CLEAR sits beside the label and never changes it
run it without --write first; write once per decision
dry_run_data: planted by _tools/tests/test_agent_docs_v1.py in a new temp folder: {SETTINGS} its settings file, {WORLD} the folder, {ALARM} this Alarm folder; run AD1_20261029, idea FLOWX
